name: The Darkest Hours of Love
source:
In a world marked by anxiety and depression, Charly steps out for the first time in months, ready to rebuild her life. As she navigates new encounters and choices, an organization may offer support – but could she also become a source of change for others?

[From [url=https://wendi-ghost.itch.io/the-darkest-hours-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个充满焦虑和抑郁的世界里，查理几个月来第一次走出去，准备重建她的生活。当她遇到新的遭遇和选择时，组织可能会提供支持——但她也能成为其他人改变的源泉吗？

[来自[url=https://wendi-ghost.itch.io/the-darkest-hours-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
